name: Metal Pro, Inc.
old_description: Since 2000, Metal Pro, Inc. has been Phoenix’s premier shop for metal fabrication projects of all types, big and small. Thanks to our highly experienced staff and state-of-the-art technologies and resources, we’re able to deliver nothing short of the highest quality results when it comes to plasma and flame cutting, tee rolling, angle irons, channel tube piping and more.
about:
Metal Pro, Inc. operates from Phoenix, Arizona, where it was established in 2000. The company has served the region for over two decades as a metal fabrication shop handling projects of varying scale.

The shop provides a range of fabrication services including plasma cutting, flame cutting, tee rolling, angle iron and channel tube piping work, CNC machining, aluminum welding, and steel fabrication. Its sawing capacity accommodates workpieces up to 14 inches by 18 inches. The facility relies on experienced personnel and modern equipment to execute custom jobs.

Metal Pro works with customers across sectors that require custom metal fabrication, from one-off prototypes to larger production runs. The company does not publicly list specific industry verticals or named clients.

According to the company, its differentiation lies in a highly experienced staff combined with state-of-the-art technologies and resources, enabling it to deliver high-quality results on diverse fabrication projects.
